what: Speaking-shot test (owner, 2026-10-19): three close-ups where one character speaks and is the main face, each animated to its finished line by Hedra (closed, run by the owner by hand on a paid plan) and by InfiniteTalk (open weights, MeiGen-AI, Apache-2.0, run by the coding agent on Modal), compared side by side with the current still. A test for the owner to judge; not part of the film.
rule: Inputs are only frames and audio that are public: the frames below (published here, the same pictures as in the public version 2 cut without its burned-in subtitle) and the finished lines (already on GitHub). No raw recording goes to either model.
